notes.title: Fixes
notes.notes: [p]Fixed the error: AttributeError: 'MainWindow' object has no attribute 'nickname'.[/p]

notes.title: New Localization
notes.notes:
[p]The latest update adds support for Spanish in the Latin America region. This improves usability for speakers of the regional Spanish variant and makes the interface more accessible.

 [/p][p]                                                          [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657117/9c104608dd94ea34c2e5c8b14d694ed78e23a156.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Achievements
notes.notes: [p][b]Working on adding Steam achievements.[/b][/p][p]At first, they will be tied to learning new word groups — so you can track your progress and earn small rewards for each step forward.[/p][p]Later, additional goals will be added: for consistency and other parameters.[/p][p]The update is already in development. More details coming soon.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657117/6769fa1f825745d97ca74ceb0d4c2622a1d70153.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Update #1
notes.notes: [p]The "Training Set" now appears first in the progress list and in dropdown menus. This was done for ease of control and selection, as it is the main library for simplified learning.[/p]
